prose: The San Francisco Chronicle reports a federal grand jury indicted OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman 'Abdul' Alfozan, a Saudi national, on a felony charge of interception of oral communications - the case of the engineer accused of bugging a San Francisco conference room used by company executives.
highlights: OpenAI engineer indicted for allegedly bugging an executive conference room
Felony charge: interception of oral communications
